channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Photos: Zelenskyy urges ‘protection of life’ amid deadly Russian attacks
item.description: Russia launches more than 70 missiles and 280 drones in a major attack on Ukraine that kills at least 14 people.

item.title: US strikes cause extensive damage on Iran’s Qeshm Island
item.description: Video from Iran's Qeshm Island shows widespread damage following US attacks.

item.title: In the waters off Malaysia, Iranian oil sales continue despite blockade
item.description: A large anchorage area off the coast of Malaysia is a major marketplace for sanctioned oil.

item.title: US launches ‘powerful’ strikes on Iran after Jordan attack
item.description: The US has bombed multiple cities across southern Iran in what Central Command described as a ‘heavy wave of strikes’.

item.title: US launches ‘heavy wave’ of new strikes on Iran
item.description: Iranian media report that a couple and their two-year-old child were killed in the latest US attacks on Qeshm island.

item.title: Israeli strikes leave buildings burning in Gaza City
item.description: Israeli strikes have displaced dozens of families in Gaza City's Shati refugee camp.

item.title: Japan turns to Canadian crude as Asia feels Hormuz supply pinch
item.description: Uncertainty over crude oil supplies via the Strait of Hormuz is pushing Asian states towards Canada's TMX crude oil.

item.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
item.description: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

item.title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war
item.description: The kingdom faces a choice of whether to keep hitting back as a deterrent or to try to de-escalate the situation.

item.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted of terror offences
item.description: Hadi Matar, 28, was convicted of attempting to help Hezbollah by attacking the British-Indian author.
